findings.what: The 'compartir' reply hands out '🌐 Ver standings en la web: https://mantia3.wpcomstaging.com/penca/g/<view_token>' which is the SAME view_token used internally for the private group standings page. Anyone with this link can see the standings without joining. The flow spec (share-link.md) explicitly requires: 'El token en el link es DIFERENTE del view_token de la group page privada (security: share-only token)'. The recent commit 67f69f3 ('Privacy fix: split share-poster token from private edit token') added a share_token field but state shows share_token='' for this user, and the share reply still reuses view_token. The /sumate/ landing page is also at /penca/g/<view_token>/sumate/, so anyone with the sumate URL can strip /sumate/ and land on standings.
findings.fix_hint: In handle_share_link / build_share_reply, when emitting the 'Ver standings en la web' link, use a separate share_token (already added per commit 67f69f3) — backfill share_token on existing groups in a migration. Or remove the standings URL from the share reply entirely; the sumate page is enough for invitees. Also gate build_join_landing_url to use share_token not view_url.
findings.evidence: 'compartir' reply: '🌐 Ver standings en la web:\nhttps://mantia3.wpcomstaging.com/penca/g/0ab4a7ff7812176ef70979bc'. State query: groups[0].view_token='0ab4a7ff7812176ef70979bc', share_token=''. Curl HEAD on /penca/g/0ab4a7ff7812176ef70979bc/ returns 301→200 with the standings page. The view_token in the group state IS the public share link.

findings.what: Bot still says 'Mantia, la app de pronósticos *mundialistas* por WhatsApp.' in multiple places. There is no Mundial in scope — the actual competitions on the picker are Libertadores 2026 and Libertadores semanal. This is the same stale-copy issue from the cold-organizer persona. It misrepresents what the product does and confuses returning users (Florencia just created a Libertadores penca and is told it's for the Mundial).
findings.fix_hint: Grep for 'mundialistas' in includes/class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php — change to 'pronósticos de fútbol' (generic) or 'pronósticos por WhatsApp' (drop the noun).

findings.what: Behavior diverges by count in a way the flow spec doesn't sanction: with 1 penca the reply is plain text + buttons ('Tu penca: *Los Pibes del 92* (código `LOSPIBESDEL928FPZW`).' + Invitar/Resumen/Crear otra). With 2 pencas it returns an Interactive List ('Estás en 2 pencas: ...'). The flow spec says EVERY listar-pencas response should be a tappable list so 'each row is tapeable'. With 1 penca the user has no list to tap — they have to remember 'partidos' or use Resumen. Minor: same row description for both pencas only shows the torneo emoji+name; spec wants 'torneo + 4 jugadores · 8 pronósticos'.
findings.fix_hint: In handle_my_groups, return an Interactive List even for N=1 (single row with the penca). Add 'X jugador · Y pronóstico' to row.description.
findings.evidence: N=1: reply 'Tu penca: *Los Pibes del 92* (código `LOSPIBESDEL928FPZW`).', interactive.type='button'. N=2: reply 'Estás en 2 pencas:...', interactive.type='list' with rows. Row description for Los Pibes del 92 is '📆 Libertadores semanal' (no player/prediction count).

findings.what: QA simulator (bin/qa-sim.php) calls Mantia_Whatsapp_Flow::maybe_handle_command directly and returns reply='' when the deterministic router returns null. The LLM fallback is never invoked from the sim — so I cannot test whether the production LLM responds usefully to 'qué hago ahora', 'explícame bien qué es esto', 'bro a qué hora juega Boca', or '2-2 Estudiantes vs Sao Paulo'. ALL four returned reply='', interactive=null, fell_through_to_llm=true in 3-7ms (no LLM round-trip). This blocks the entire fallback-llm flow from being QA-able via the simulator harness.
findings.fix_hint: Extend bin/qa-sim.php to invoke the LLM agent (Mantia_Agent::respond or equivalent) when maybe_handle_command returns null, mirroring the production webhook path. Add a 'mock_llm' switch so CI runs are deterministic. Without this, the LLM path has zero automated coverage.
findings.evidence: Four representative inputs all return {reply:'', interactive:null, fell_through_to_llm:true, elapsed_ms:3-7}. bin/qa-sim.php:72 calls only Mantia_Whatsapp_Flow::maybe_handle_command and treats null as terminal. Production wires the flow via 'openclawp_pre_chat_turn' filter — returning null there lets the LLM handle the turn, which the sim never exercises.

findings.what: Could not verify the spec requirement 'Si el match ya empezó (kickoff < now), el bot DEBE rechazar la edición'. Match Bolívar vs Cerro Porteño shows 'Tue 19 May • 19:00' and current UTC is 19:31. Bot accepted '3-2' without complaint and re-tapping the match still offered to overwrite. Either the kickoff is in a later timezone (so not actually started yet) or the guard is missing. Worth a direct DB check.
findings.fix_hint: Add a unit test that seeds a match with kickoff_utc = now - 5min and asserts that handle_score_pending / handle_match_detail responds with 'El partido ya arrancó'. Or, if the guard exists but the seed data puts kickoffs in the future, document the test fixture timezone.
findings.evidence: reply at 19:31 UTC to mantia:match:6382 (Bolívar vs Cerro Porteño Tue 19 May 19:00): 'Pronóstico actual: *3-2* — mandame uno nuevo (ej *2-1*).' No 'ya arrancó' rejection.

findings.what: Share reply takes 465-519ms across 2 calls, with no LLM involvement (it's a templated string with member lookup). Other deterministic replies in the same session (mis pencas: 7-11ms, slim detail: 11-16ms, score commit: 67ms) are ~50× faster. Suggests an N+1 or external lookup (OG render? share_token mint?) on the share path. Not a blocker but noticeable on a single-tap button.
findings.fix_hint: Profile handle_share_link — likely culprits: (1) syncing the share token lazily on first use, (2) re-rendering the OG image, (3) refetching member roster from remote. Cache the share string per group with a short TTL.
findings.evidence: elapsed_ms for 'compartir': 465. elapsed_ms for 'mantia:cmd:share-link': 519. elapsed_ms for 'mis pencas': 11. elapsed_ms for slim detail tap: 11-16. elapsed_ms for score commit '3-2': 67.
